% Pattern: number/equation. The rows of a split in an align are one equation,
% so the align with a split steps the equation counter once, the align with two
% rows twice, and the definition that shares the counter after them is 1.4. Seen
% in the gold pilot (set X).
% want definition-1 definition 1.4
\documentclass{amsart}
\numberwithin{equation}{section}
\newtheorem{definition}[equation]{Definition}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{align}
\begin{split}
a &= b + c \\
  &= d
\end{split}
\end{align}
\begin{align}
e &= f \\
g &= h
\end{align}
\begin{definition} A space is fine when it is compact. \end{definition}
\end{document}
